Avicenna Research <no-reply@avicennaresearch.com>:
Friday, September 20, 2024 9:12 AM To: Joanne Chung <joanne.chung@utoronto.ca> Subject: Data for your study will be deleted in 1 day You don't often get email from no-reply@avicennaresearch.com. Learn why this is important Just a friendly reminder about your data deletion Hi Joanne, We wanted to let you know that your trial study on Avicenna Research, #3748, titled "Daily Life at UTM (Winter 2024)" will reset in 1 day . This means all data collected so far as part of this study will be removed. Why my study's data is being erased? We regularly clean up trial studies on Avicenna. Of course, you can collect new data for this study, and continue trying out Avicenna. If you would like to keep the study data, please consider purchasing a license. You can do so by contacting sales@avicennaresearch.com . What exactly is being erased Every data that is received from any of the participants, including sensor data, survey responses, cognitive tasks, and participant history. Currently, enrolled participants remain enrolled and can continue uploading data to your study. How should I stop this? If you need to keep these data in your Avicenna account, please contact sales@avicennaresearch.com and we will be able to help you acquire a license. Thanks for using our site!
